summary.name: Cited By AI
summary.one_liner: Cited By AI® is a UK ASEO consultancy and audit service that measures and improves how often brands are cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot and Google AI Overviews, with a free CPS® Lite checker.
keywords: how to get cited by chatgpt
use_cases: check whether ChatGPT or Perplexity mention your brand
find AI crawler blocks on a website
detect wrong facts AI states about a company
score a page's likelihood of being cited by AI
track AI share of voice against competitors
generate schema markup and llms.txt files
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a 28-module AI visibility audit covering AI Share of Voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Overviews, with breakdowns by funnel stage and buyer persona. It includes an AI Accuracy Audit that checks AI answers against verified brand facts, per-page Citability Scores (0–100) with rewrite recommendations, and AI crawler access checks for 15 bots. Deliverables include schema and llms.txt files, a priority action plan, and scheduled monitoring with email alerts. The Citation Probability Score (CPS) rates pages 0–100 across five pillars: Content Structure, Fact Density, Answer Architecture, Self-Containment and Freshness.
notable: AI Accuracy Audit that checks what AI says about a brand, not only how often it mentions it
Citation Probability Score (CPS) 0–100 with five weighted pillars
Free CPS Lite checker, also available via MCP
Human spot-checks of top prompts on real devices alongside automated API analysis
caveats: Paid service: £49 Solo audit, then £99–149/month or retainers from £750/month with 3–6 month minimum commitments depending on tier
Page itself notes schema and llms.txt are not required for Google AI Overviews or AI Mode, and the page claims they are not the main citation lever
Vendor marketing claims (e.g. '73% of sites have a crawler barrier') are from its own audits and are not independently verified
